operations.label: G1 ADD
operations.note: BN254: EIP-1108 (Istanbul). BLS12-381: EIP-2537 (Pectra). Larger field doubles cost.

operations.label: G1 MUL
operations.note: BN254: EIP-1108. BLS12-381: EIP-2537. 381-bit field ~2× the 254-bit field scalar work.

operations.label: G2 MUL
operations.note: BN254 has no native G2 precompile — estimate for optimised EVM bytecode (1–5M gas range). BLS12-381: 22,500 gas native (EIP-2537). 67× reduction at midpoint.

operations.label: PAIRING k=3
operations.note: BN254: 34,000×3 + 45,000 = 147,000 gas. BLS12-381: 32,600×3 + 37,700 = 135,500 gas. BLS12-381 is 8% cheaper — useful for Groth16 (4 pairings) and PLONK verifiers.
